tools.name: pixever_media_list
tools.description: Lista paginada (cursor-based) de media visible del feed de un Pixever. Pixevers públicos no requieren `token`; cerrados/semi-privados sí (el x-guest-token de un invitado ya registrado). Usa `pageInfo.endCursor` de la respuesta como `after` para pedir la siguiente página. Solo lectura.

tools.name: pixever_upload_media
tools.description: ÚNICA tool de escritura: descarga una imagen pública desde `source_url` y la sube a `POST /api/v1/pixevers/:slug/media` a nombre del invitado dueño de `token` (x-guest-token, requerido — sin token no hay escritura). Solo imágenes (jpeg/png/webp/heic/heif, máx 20 MB); no video, no creación de Pixever

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "pixever_interactions" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pixever_media_list · Private data: pixever_media_list, pixever_upload_link, pixever_upload_media, pixever_react, pixever_star, pixever_interactions · Public sink: pixever_upload_link, pixever_upload_media · Destructive: pixever_react.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pixever_media_list · Private data: pixever_media_list, pixever_upload_link, pixever_upload_media, pixever_react, pixever_star, pixever_interactions · Public sink: pixever_upload_link, pixever_upload_media · Destructive: pixever_react

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
